_comment: engine_Dev — built-in (Tartaria) power disciplines: the LAST-RESORT default power set. An uploaded 'powers' table replaces these, and the generic-default pack (GENERIC_POWERS) supplies bland disciplines for a reskin. Moved out of engine source so powers.ts carries no hardcoded setting strings. The shape/summon/mend effect PRIMITIVES stay in the engine.

powers.name: Aetherstone Manipulation
powers.title: Aetherstone Manipulation (shape)
powers.body: INT check, DC 12. In combat: +4 AC for one turn (shaped-stone ward). Out of combat: binds an Aetheric Shard to a Small Rock, producing a throwable Shaped Aetheric Shard. Power affinity (set per race) adjusts the DC.

powers.name: Aether Golem Constructor
powers.title: Aether Golem Constructor (summon)
powers.body: INT check, DC 15 (harder than the other two — golems take stronger anchors). Summons a golem ally that fights for you for the rest of the scene. Power affinity (set per race) adjusts the DC.

powers.name: Aetheric Healing
powers.title: Aetheric Healing (mend)
powers.body: WIS check, DC 12. Restores HP to you or an ally. Aetherborn pay HP instead of corruption when they cast this — racial trait. Power affinity (set per race) adjusts the DC.
